swms.title: General Site Safety — High Risk Construction Work
swms.workActivity: General construction site activities including site establishment, material handling, and general labour tasks on a high risk construction site.
swms.hazards: Uneven ground and trip hazards; falling objects from overhead work; moving plant and machinery; manual handling injuries; electrical hazards from temporary power; dust and noise exposure; UV radiation; heat stress.
swms.risks: Slips, trips and falls; struck by falling objects; crush injuries from plant; musculoskeletal injuries; electrocution; respiratory illness; hearing damage; heat exhaustion.
swms.controls: Conduct daily site inspection before work commences. Ensure all workers have current site induction. Maintain clear pedestrian pathways separated from plant movement zones. Erect exclusion zones under overhead work. All electrical equipment to be tested and tagged. Provide and enforce use of appropriate PPE. Implement heat management plan in hot weather. Conduct regular toolbox talks.
swms.ppe: Hard hat (AS/NZS 1801); High visibility vest (Class D/N); Safety boots with steel cap (AS/NZS 2210.3); Safety glasses (AS/NZS 1337); Hearing protection where noise >85dB; Sunscreen SPF50+ and sun-protective clothing; Gloves for manual handling tasks.
swms.plantEquipment: Excavators, skid steers, forklifts, elevated work platforms, concrete pumps, generators, power tools, hand tools.
swms.trainingCompetency: All workers must hold a current General Construction Induction (White Card). Plant operators must hold relevant high risk work licences. First aid officer on site at all times. Emergency warden designated.
swms.emergencyControls: Emergency assembly point clearly marked at site entry. First aid kit location communicated at induction. Nearest hospital: confirm at site establishment. Emergency contacts posted in site office. Incident reporting procedure communicated to all workers.
swms.environmentalControls: Sediment and erosion controls installed prior to earthworks. Concrete washout area designated. Hazardous materials stored in bunded area. Dust suppression by water cart as required. No burning of waste on site.
swms.signOffRequirements: Site supervisor sign-off required before work commences each day. All workers to sign attendance register. SWMS to be reviewed and re-signed if scope of work changes.

swms.title: Working at Heights
swms.workActivity: Any work performed at a height of 2 metres or more above the ground or a floor level, including roof work, scaffold erection, use of ladders, and elevated work platforms.
swms.hazards: Falls from height; falling tools and materials; unstable working surfaces; inadequate edge protection; ladder instability; EWP tip-over; adverse weather conditions.
swms.risks: Fatal or serious injury from falls; struck by falling objects; EWP rollover; electrocution from overhead power lines.
swms.controls: Eliminate the need to work at heights where possible through design. Use scaffolding with full edge protection (toe boards, mid-rails, top rails) as the preferred method. EWP to be used where scaffold is not practicable. Ladders only for access/egress, not as a working platform. Establish exclusion zones below work area. Inspect all equipment before use. Check weather forecast — cease work in winds >40km/h. Overhead power line exclusion zone minimum 3m (6.4m for 11kV+).
swms.ppe: Hard hat; Safety harness (AS/NZS 1891.1) with double lanyard when working on roof or unprotected edges; Safety boots; High visibility vest; Safety glasses; Gloves.
swms.plantEquipment: Scaffolding (AS/NZS 4576); Elevated Work Platforms (EWP); Extension ladders (AS/NZS 1892); Safety harness and lanyards; Anchor points.
swms.trainingCompetency: Scaffold erectors must hold a scaffolding licence (basic, intermediate or advanced as required). EWP operators must hold a relevant high risk work licence (WP class). All workers working at heights must be trained in harness use and rescue procedures.
swms.emergencyControls: Rescue plan in place for suspended worker. First aid officer on site. Emergency services contact numbers posted. Rescue equipment (rope, harness) accessible at height work areas.
swms.environmentalControls: Secure all materials and tools at height to prevent them falling. Use tool lanyards. Debris netting where required. Cease work in lightning, high winds or heavy rain.
swms.signOffRequirements: Supervisor to inspect scaffold and edge protection before each shift. Workers to sign SWMS before commencing work at heights. Permit to work required for unprotected roof edges.

swms.title: Excavation and Trenching
swms.workActivity: Excavation and trenching operations including machine excavation, hand digging, installation of underground services, and backfilling.
swms.hazards: Trench collapse and engulfment; underground services (gas, electrical, water, telecommunications); falling into excavation; plant operating near excavation edge; flooding; toxic or oxygen-deficient atmosphere.
swms.risks: Fatal engulfment from trench collapse; electrocution from underground cables; gas explosion; drowning; crush injuries from plant.
swms.controls: Obtain Dial Before You Dig (DBYD) report before any excavation. Pothole to confirm service locations. Maintain minimum 600mm clearance from services. Shore, batter or bench all trenches deeper than 1.5m. Establish exclusion zones around excavation edges. No plant within 1m of trench edge without engineer approval. Inspect trench walls after rain or vibration. Atmospheric testing in confined trenches. Dewatering pump on standby.
swms.ppe: Hard hat; High visibility vest; Safety boots; Safety glasses; Gloves; Hearing protection when operating plant.
swms.plantEquipment: Excavators; Trench shoring systems; Dewatering pumps; Atmospheric gas monitors; Dial Before You Dig service locator; Hand tools.
swms.trainingCompetency: Excavator operators must hold a relevant high risk work licence. Supervisor must be competent in trench safety assessment. Workers must be trained in confined space entry if applicable.
swms.emergencyControls: Rescue plan for trench collapse — do not enter collapsed trench. Call 000 immediately. Trench rescue equipment (rope, board) on site. First aid officer on site.
swms.environmentalControls: Sediment controls at trench entry/exit points. Spoil stored minimum 600mm from trench edge. Dewatering discharge to sediment basin. Protect tree root zones from excavation.
swms.signOffRequirements: Supervisor to inspect trench before workers enter each shift. DBYD report to be on site. Workers to sign SWMS before commencing excavation.

swms.title: Concrete Placement and Finishing
swms.workActivity: Receiving, placing, vibrating, screeding, and finishing concrete including slab-on-ground, footings, columns, and elevated slabs. Includes use of concrete pump and agitator trucks.
swms.hazards: Concrete burns (alkaline burns to skin and eyes); manual handling of heavy loads; concrete pump hose whip; agitator truck movement; vibration from power tools; slippery surfaces; working in formwork.
swms.risks: Chemical burns from wet concrete; musculoskeletal injuries; struck by pump hose; crush injuries from agitator truck; hand-arm vibration syndrome; falls on wet surfaces.
swms.controls: Wear full PPE including waterproof gloves and rubber boots when handling wet concrete. Wash skin immediately if contact occurs. Establish truck exclusion zone — spotter required for reversing. Concrete pump operator to hold relevant licence. Inspect pump hoses and couplings before use. Ensure formwork is inspected and certified before pour. Provide non-slip surfaces in work area. Rotate workers on vibrating equipment to limit exposure.
swms.ppe: Hard hat; High visibility vest; Rubber boots (knee-high); Waterproof gloves; Safety glasses or face shield; Hearing protection when using vibrators.
swms.plantEquipment: Concrete agitator trucks; Concrete pump; Internal vibrators; Screed rails; Power floats; Hand tools (rakes, trowels, floats).
swms.trainingCompetency: Concrete pump operator must hold a relevant high risk work licence. Formwork must be designed and certified by a structural engineer for elevated slabs. Workers trained in concrete burn first aid.
swms.emergencyControls: Eyewash station on site. First aid kit with burn treatment supplies. Nearest hospital confirmed. Formwork collapse rescue plan in place.
swms.environmentalControls: Concrete washout area designated and bunded. No concrete to enter stormwater drains. Excess concrete to be returned to plant or disposed of in designated washout area.
swms.signOffRequirements: Formwork inspection sign-off before pour commences. Supervisor to confirm pump setup and exclusion zones. Workers to sign SWMS before pour.

swms.title: Demolition — Minor Works
swms.workActivity: Minor demolition including removal of non-structural walls, ceilings, flooring, fixtures, and fittings. Excludes structural demolition which requires a separate SWMS.
swms.hazards: Asbestos-containing materials (ACM); lead paint; structural instability; falling debris; dust inhalation; manual handling; electrical hazards; noise.
swms.risks: Asbestos-related disease; lead poisoning; structural collapse; injury from falling debris; respiratory illness; musculoskeletal injuries; electrocution.
swms.controls: Conduct asbestos survey before any demolition. If ACM identified, engage licensed asbestos removalist. Isolate and lock out all electrical circuits in work area. Assess structural stability before removing any element. Wet down surfaces to suppress dust. Establish exclusion zone around demolition area. Segregate and label all waste. Lead paint — use wet methods and P2 respirator.
swms.ppe: Hard hat; High visibility vest; Safety boots; Safety glasses; P2 respirator (minimum) for dust; Disposable coveralls for asbestos/lead work; Gloves; Hearing protection.
swms.plantEquipment: Angle grinders; Reciprocating saws; Jackhammers; Pry bars; Dust extraction units; Skip bins.
swms.trainingCompetency: Asbestos awareness training for all workers. Licensed asbestos removalist for any friable or bonded ACM removal. Supervisor to hold demolition competency.
swms.emergencyControls: If unexpected ACM discovered — stop work, isolate area, notify supervisor. Do not disturb. Engage licensed assessor. First aid kit on site.
swms.environmentalControls: Asbestos waste to be double-bagged, labelled and disposed of at licensed facility. Lead paint waste segregated. Dust suppression throughout. No burning of demolition waste.
swms.signOffRequirements: Asbestos survey report on site before work commences. Electrical isolation certificate on site. Workers to sign SWMS. Supervisor sign-off each day.

swms.title: Electrical Work — General
swms.workActivity: Electrical installation, maintenance, testing, and inspection work including switchboard work, cable installation, fitting of outlets and fixtures, and testing and tagging.
swms.hazards: Electric shock and electrocution; arc flash; fire from electrical fault; working in confined spaces; falls from ladders; manual handling.
swms.risks: Fatal electrocution; severe burns from arc flash; fire; musculoskeletal injuries.
swms.controls: All electrical work to be performed by a licensed electrician. Isolate and lock out circuits before commencing work — use LOTO procedure. Test for dead before touching any conductor. Use insulated tools rated for the voltage. Wear arc flash PPE for switchboard work. Never work on live circuits unless absolutely necessary and with a permit to work. Inspect all tools and leads before use — test and tag current.
swms.ppe: Hard hat (non-conductive); Safety boots (non-conductive sole); Insulated gloves rated for voltage; Arc flash face shield and flame-resistant clothing for switchboard work; Safety glasses.
swms.plantEquipment: Multimeter; Insulated tools; LOTO devices; Test and tag equipment; Cable pulling equipment; Conduit bender.
swms.trainingCompetency: All electrical work must be performed by a licensed electrician (A-grade or restricted as applicable). Workers must be trained in LOTO procedures. First aid officer with CPR/AED training on site.
swms.emergencyControls: Do not touch a person in contact with live electricity. Isolate power first. Call 000. CPR-trained first aider on site. AED location communicated at induction.
swms.environmentalControls: Dispose of electrical waste (cables, fittings) in accordance with local regulations. No burning of cable insulation.
swms.signOffRequirements: Electrical isolation certificate before work on any circuit. Supervisor sign-off on LOTO procedure. Compliance certificate on completion.

swms.title: Plumbing and Drainage
swms.workActivity: Installation, maintenance, and repair of plumbing systems including water supply, drainage, hot water systems, gas fitting, and stormwater.
swms.hazards: Excavation hazards for underground work; hot water burns; gas leaks; confined space entry; manual handling; working at heights for roof drainage; chemical exposure from solvents and flux.
swms.risks: Burns from hot water/steam; gas explosion; engulfment in excavation; musculoskeletal injuries; chemical burns; falls.
swms.controls: Isolate water supply before commencing work on pressurised systems. Purge and test gas lines before and after work. Obtain gas work permit. Excavation SWMS to apply for underground work. Use appropriate PPE when handling chemicals. Ensure hot water systems are set to correct temperature (60°C storage, 50°C delivery to prevent scalding). Confined space entry procedure for work in pits.
swms.ppe: Hard hat; High visibility vest; Safety boots; Safety glasses; Chemical-resistant gloves for solvent/flux work; Hearing protection when using power tools.
swms.plantEquipment: Pipe cutters; Soldering equipment; Pipe threading machine; Drain camera; Pressure testing equipment; Excavation equipment (refer to Excavation SWMS).
swms.trainingCompetency: All plumbing and gas work must be performed by a licensed plumber/gasfitter. Workers must be trained in confined space entry if applicable.
swms.emergencyControls: Gas leak — evacuate area, call gas supplier emergency line and 000. Do not use electrical switches. Water leak — isolate supply. Burns — cool with running water for 20 minutes.
swms.environmentalControls: Prevent solvent and chemical spills entering stormwater. Dispose of chemical waste correctly. Protect waterways from sediment during excavation.
swms.signOffRequirements: Compliance certificate on completion of all licensed work. Pressure test results recorded. Workers to sign SWMS.

swms.title: Roofing — Metal and Tile
swms.workActivity: Installation, repair, and maintenance of metal roofing (Colorbond, corrugated iron, standing seam) and tile roofing (concrete and terracotta tiles). Includes guttering and downpipe installation.
swms.hazards: Falls from roof edge; falls through fragile roof surfaces (skylights, fibro, corroded sheeting); sharp metal edges; manual handling of heavy tiles; UV radiation; heat stress; adverse weather; overhead power lines.
swms.risks: Fatal or serious injury from falls; lacerations from metal edges; musculoskeletal injuries; heat exhaustion; electrocution from power lines.
swms.controls: Establish edge protection (scaffolding, safety mesh, or catch platform) before commencing roof work. Never walk on fibro/asbestos cement sheeting or fragile skylights — use roof ladders or crawl boards. Identify and maintain exclusion zone from overhead power lines (minimum 3m). Work in cooler parts of the day in summer. Wear cut-resistant gloves when handling metal sheeting. Secure all materials and tools on roof. Cease work in winds >40km/h or lightning.
swms.ppe: Hard hat; Safety harness with double lanyard anchored to certified anchor points; Safety boots with non-slip soles; Cut-resistant gloves; Safety glasses; High visibility vest; Sun protection.
swms.plantEquipment: Scaffolding; Roof ladders and crawl boards; Safety harness and anchor points; Tin snips; Nibblers; Screw guns; Tile cutters.
swms.trainingCompetency: Roofing workers must be trained in working at heights and harness use. Scaffold must be erected by licensed scaffolder. Asbestos awareness training required.
swms.emergencyControls: Rescue plan for suspended worker. First aid officer on site. Emergency contacts posted. Cease work and evacuate in lightning.
swms.environmentalControls: Secure all materials to prevent wind-blown debris. Collect and dispose of metal offcuts. Protect gutters from debris during installation.
swms.signOffRequirements: Scaffold inspection certificate before work commences. Anchor point certification on site. Workers to sign SWMS. Supervisor daily sign-off.

swms.title: Crane and Rigging Operations
swms.workActivity: Crane lifts including mobile crane, tower crane, and franna crane operations. Rigging of loads including structural steel, precast panels, plant and equipment.
swms.hazards: Load drop or swing; crane tip-over; rigging failure; workers in the drop zone; overhead power lines; ground instability under crane; communication failure.
swms.risks: Fatal crush injury from dropped or swinging load; crane collapse; electrocution from power lines; structural damage.
swms.controls: Lift study/plan required for all lifts. Crane to be set up on firm, level ground — engineer certification for soft ground. Establish exclusion zone equal to load radius plus 20%. Dogman to direct all lifts — no lift without dogman in visual contact. All rigging equipment to be inspected and rated for the load. Overhead power line exclusion zone — minimum 3m (contact supply authority for higher voltages). Two-way radio communication between crane operator and dogman. No personnel under suspended load.
swms.ppe: Hard hat; High visibility vest; Safety boots; Gloves; Safety glasses.
swms.plantEquipment: Mobile crane; Tower crane; Franna crane; Slings (chain, wire rope, webbing); Shackles; Spreader beams; Lifting lugs.
swms.trainingCompetency: Crane operator must hold a relevant high risk work licence (C2, C6 etc.). Dogman must hold a dogging licence (DG). Rigger must hold a rigging licence (RB, RI, RA as required). Lift study to be prepared by competent person.
swms.emergencyControls: If load drops — evacuate exclusion zone immediately. Call 000 if injury. Do not approach unstable crane. Incident notification to regulator required for dangerous incidents.
swms.environmentalControls: Hydraulic fluid spill kit on crane. Protect ground surface from crane outrigger loads. Noise management for residential areas.
swms.signOffRequirements: Lift study signed off by supervisor before lift. Rigging equipment inspection records on site. Workers to sign SWMS. Crane operator pre-start checklist completed.

swms.title: Confined Space Entry
swms.workActivity: Entry into confined spaces including pits, tanks, vaults, manholes, tunnels, and enclosed areas with restricted entry/exit and potential for hazardous atmosphere.
swms.hazards: Oxygen deficiency or enrichment; toxic gases (H2S, CO, methane); flammable atmosphere; engulfment; restricted entry/exit for rescue; heat stress; noise.
swms.risks: Asphyxiation; explosion; toxic gas poisoning; entrapment; heat exhaustion.
swms.controls: Confined space entry permit required before entry. Atmospheric testing (O2, CO, H2S, LEL) before and continuously during entry. Ventilate space before and during entry. Standby person at entry point at all times — never enters space. Rescue plan and equipment in place before entry. Isolate all energy sources (LOTO). Communicate with entrant at regular intervals. Entrant to wear harness for retrieval.
swms.ppe: Hard hat; Safety harness with retrieval line; SCBA or airline breathing apparatus if atmosphere cannot be made safe; Safety boots; Gloves; Intrinsically safe lighting and equipment.
swms.plantEquipment: Atmospheric gas monitor (4-gas); Forced ventilation fan; Tripod and winch for retrieval; SCBA; Intrinsically safe lighting; LOTO devices.
swms.trainingCompetency: Entry supervisor must hold confined space entry supervisor competency. Entrants and standby person must hold confined space training. Rescue team trained and equipped.
swms.emergencyControls: Do not enter to rescue without SCBA and trained rescue team. Retrieve entrant using tripod/winch if possible. Call 000. Rescue plan posted at entry point.
swms.environmentalControls: Prevent contaminants from entering confined space during work. Dispose of any materials removed from space correctly.
swms.signOffRequirements: Confined space entry permit signed by supervisor before each entry. Atmospheric test results recorded. Rescue plan signed off. Workers to sign SWMS.

swms.title: Hot Works — Welding, Cutting and Grinding
swms.workActivity: Hot works including arc welding, oxy-acetylene cutting, plasma cutting, angle grinding, and any work that produces sparks, heat, or open flame.
swms.hazards: Fire and explosion; UV radiation from welding arc; fumes and gases; burns; electric shock (arc welding); compressed gas cylinder hazards; noise; eye injury from grinding sparks.
swms.risks: Fire; explosion of flammable materials; arc eye; respiratory illness from fumes; burns; electrocution; hearing damage.
swms.controls: Hot work permit required in all areas except designated welding bays. Clear combustible materials minimum 10m from hot work area. Fire watch for minimum 30 minutes after hot work ceases. Inspect area for smouldering materials. Ensure adequate ventilation — use LEV for welding fumes. Inspect welding leads and equipment before use. Secure gas cylinders upright. Flashback arrestors on oxy-acetylene equipment. Grinding disc rated for tool RPM.
swms.ppe: Welding helmet with correct shade lens; Leather welding gloves; Leather apron or welding jacket; Safety boots; Hearing protection; P2 respirator for welding fumes; Safety glasses under welding helmet.
swms.plantEquipment: Welding machine; Oxy-acetylene set with flashback arrestors; Plasma cutter; Angle grinder; Fire extinguisher (CO2 or dry powder); Fire blanket.
swms.trainingCompetency: Welders must hold relevant trade qualification or demonstrated competency. Hot work permit issuer must be trained. Fire warden designated.
swms.emergencyControls: Fire extinguisher and fire blanket at hot work location. Fire warden on site. Evacuation plan posted. Call 000 for fire. Burns — cool with running water 20 minutes.
swms.environmentalControls: Collect grinding sparks and metal offcuts. Dispose of electrode stubs correctly. Prevent welding spatter from igniting vegetation.
swms.signOffRequirements: Hot work permit signed before work commences. Fire watch log maintained. Workers to sign SWMS. Supervisor sign-off.

swms.title: Asbestos Awareness — Incidental Disturbance
swms.workActivity: Work activities where asbestos-containing materials (ACM) may be incidentally disturbed, including drilling, cutting, or removing materials in buildings constructed before 1990.
swms.hazards: Inhalation of asbestos fibres causing mesothelioma, lung cancer, and asbestosis; unexpected discovery of ACM during renovation or demolition.
swms.risks: Fatal asbestos-related disease from fibre inhalation.
swms.controls: Assume all materials in pre-1990 buildings may contain asbestos until proven otherwise. Obtain asbestos register or survey before commencing work. If ACM identified — stop work, do not disturb, notify supervisor. Engage licensed asbestos assessor to test and identify. Licensed asbestos removalist for removal of >10m2 non-friable or any friable ACM. Wet methods to suppress dust if minor disturbance unavoidable. Decontamination procedure on exit from work area.
swms.ppe: P2 respirator (minimum) — full-face respirator with P3 filter for higher risk; Disposable coveralls (Tyvek); Rubber gloves; Safety boots (cleanable).
swms.plantEquipment: Asbestos identification test kits; Wet spray equipment; Asbestos waste bags (double-bag, labelled); Decontamination unit for licensed removal.
swms.trainingCompetency: All workers must complete asbestos awareness training. Asbestos removal supervisor must hold a supervisory certificate. Licensed removalist for removal work.
swms.emergencyControls: If unexpected ACM disturbed — stop work immediately. Isolate area. Do not re-enter without P2 respirator. Notify supervisor and WHS regulator if required.
swms.environmentalControls: Asbestos waste double-bagged in labelled asbestos waste bags. Disposed of at licensed facility. Decontaminate tools and equipment before removing from work area.
swms.signOffRequirements: Asbestos register/survey on site before work commences. Workers to sign SWMS confirming asbestos awareness training. Supervisor sign-off.
